prompt:
The manager of the canteen at your workplace has asked members of staff to send written suggestions about the service.

Write a letter to the manager. In your letter:

- say how often you use the canteen and when
- describe one thing that does not work well
- suggest two changes that would improve the service
instruction_line: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task. Write at least 150 words.
key_points: State how often and at what time you use the canteen — this information makes the suggestion credible
Choose a single problem and describe it concretely (queues, seating, limited choice, opening hours)
Two separate suggestions must be given and both should be workable; watch the number required
Link the suggestions to the problem: show how each suggestion reduces which issue
The tone is semi-formal and constructive: criticism is present but the decision is left to the manager
common_mistakes: Listing problems at length without writing a single suggestion
Giving only one suggestion when two are required
Writing a complaint letter instead of a constructive suggestion
Skipping the frequency-of-use point and starting directly with the problem
topic: suggestion letter about a workplace canteen
